q: Do I need to know my exact birth time?
a: The more precise the birth time, the more accurate the chart. Share what you have — I apply rectification techniques to narrow it down if needed.

q: Is Jyotish about predicting the future?
a: Not in the sense of fixed predictions. Jyotish is a reflective framework for understanding patterns and timing — free will always applies and nothing is guaranteed. The reading helps you reflect on your current chapter and choose your next steps with more awareness. It is not medical, legal or financial advice.

q: How is this different from Sun-sign horoscopes?
a: Quite different. Vedic astrology uses your exact birth chart across 16 divisional charts, planetary periods, and classical techniques. A Sun-sign column uses one of dozens of factors.

q: What do I share after booking?
a: Date of birth, exact time of birth, and place of birth — sent over WhatsApp after booking. You can also share the main area of life you want to focus on.
